types.explanation: Informational: Continue - server has received initial part of request and client should continue.
Informational: Switching Protocols - server agrees to switch protocols.
Successful: OK - request succeeded, payload carries representation.
Successful: Created - new resource created as result of request.
Successful: Accepted - request accepted for processing but not completed.
Successful: Non-Authoritative Information - transformation applied by intermediary.
Successful: No Content - request fulfilled, no additional content.
Successful: Reset Content - user agent should reset document view.
Successful: Partial Content - partial representation transferred for range request.
Redirection: Multiple Choices - multiple representations available.
Redirection: Moved Permanently - resource assigned new permanent URI.
Redirection: Found - resource temporarily under different URI.
Redirection: See Other - redirect to different resource.
Redirection: Not Modified - conditional GET, resource not modified, use cached version.
Redirection: Use Proxy - deprecated, indicates resource must be accessed through proxy.
Redirection: Temporary Redirect - temporary redirect, method must not change.
Client Error: Bad Request - server cannot process due to malformed syntax.
Client Error: Unauthorized - lacks valid authentication credentials.
Client Error: Payment Required - reserved for future use.
Client Error: Forbidden - server understood but refuses authorization.
Client Error: Not Found - origin server did not find representation.
Client Error: Method Not Allowed - method not allowed for target resource.
Client Error: Not Acceptable - resource does not have acceptable representation.
Client Error: Proxy Authentication Required - client must authenticate with proxy.
Client Error: Request Timeout - server did not receive complete request within time.
Client Error: Conflict - request conflicts with current state of resource.
Client Error: Gone - resource no longer available and no forwarding address.
Client Error: Length Required - server refuses request without Content-Length.
Client Error: Precondition Failed - one or more conditions given in request header evaluated false.
Client Error: Payload Too Large - request payload larger than server willing to process.
Client Error: URI Too Long - request-target longer than server willing to interpret.
Client Error: Unsupported Media Type - payload format not supported.
Client Error: Range Not Satisfiable - none of the ranges in request overlap current extent.
Client Error: Expectation Failed - expectation in Expect header could not be met.
Client Error: Upgrade Required - server refuses to perform request using current protocol.
Server Error: Internal Server Error - server encountered unexpected condition.
Server Error: Not Implemented - server does not support functionality required.
Server Error: Bad Gateway - invalid response from upstream server.
Server Error: Service Unavailable - temporarily unable to handle request due to overload or maintenance.
Server Error: Gateway Timeout - did not receive timely response from upstream server.
Server Error: HTTP Version Not Supported - server does not support major protocol version.
